import pandas as pd
import numpy as np

def run(inputs: dict) -> dict:
    df = inputs["payments"].copy()

    amount = df["amount"]
    currency = df["currency"]
    country = df["country"]

    cond_r1 = amount.isna()
    cond_r2 = (~cond_r1) & (amount <= 0)
    cond_r3 = (~cond_r1) & (~cond_r2) & (~currency.isin(["USD", "EUR", "GBP"]))
    cond_r4 = (~cond_r1) & (~cond_r2) & (~cond_r3) & (country.isna())

    reason_code = np.select(
        [cond_r1, cond_r2, cond_r3, cond_r4],
        ["AMT_NULL", "AMT_NONPOS", "CCY_INVALID", "CTRY_NULL"],
        default=None
    )
    reason_code = pd.Series(reason_code, index=df.index)

    is_rejected = reason_code.notna()

    clean_df = df.loc[~is_rejected].copy()
    clean_df["amount"] = clean_df["amount"].round(2)
    clean_df = clean_df[["payment_id", "amount", "currency", "country"]]

    rejects_df = df.loc[is_rejected].copy()
    rejects_df["reason_code"] = reason_code.loc[is_rejected]
    rejects_df = rejects_df[["payment_id", "amount", "currency", "country", "reason_code"]]

    return {
        "payments_clean": clean_df.reset_index(drop=True),
        "payments_rejects": rejects_df.reset_index(drop=True)
    }
